diagnosis: The SAML strategy callback uses tenantId from the URL path parameter to resolve the tenant context. However, it does not verify whether the SAML assertion issuer (profile.issuer) is the configured Identity Provider for that specific tenant. An attacker authenticating through their own company's SAML IdP can substitute another tenantId in the callback URL to log in as any user matching their email in the target tenant.
exploit_request:
POST /auth/saml/callback/tnt_victim_acme_corp HTTP/1.1
Host: sso.enterprisegateway.com
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
